name: go-documentation
description: > Go documentation conventions: godoc comments, package docs, testable Example functions, deprecation notices, doc links, and project docs (README, CHANGELOG, llms.txt). Use when: "add godoc", "document this package", "write doc comments", "add examples to docs", "deprecate a function", "write a README", "update the changelog", "improve the docs". Not for: commit messages (git-commit), code style (go-coding-standards).
